reading.body:
CyrusOne Sterling (NVA4) publishes 11 MW of IT capacity, placing it 22nd of 25 Virginia facilities with disclosed capacity and outside the tier that shapes near-term AI scaling.

The facility spans 128,715 square feet of technical space, which at a common 40 kW per rack implies roughly 275 racks. It holds 0.7% of Virginia's disclosed 1,603 MW, and most of the state's 330 mapped data centers publish no capacity at all, so the disclosed set is sparse. NVA4 is an existing CyrusOne asset with no published certifications.

For AI, the modest 11 MW load means this site is not among the large compute buildings that drive near-term power constraints in Virginia. The data does not include grid supply, interconnection queue position, or announced expansion, so it cannot show whether the facility could add capacity or support AI training at scale. The suitability score of 57 reflects only published IT capacity and operator type, with expansion data missing.
